items.name: DACAT ROOKIE CARD 2026 - FIRST ROUND
items.description:
The 2026 DACAT ROOKIE CARD is a limited-edition community NFT created to welcome new members to DACAT. Only 333 First Round DACAT Rookie Cards will be issued for 2026. Additional subsequent rookie  rounds may be introduced in the future.

These cards are awarded by members of the DACAT Community to individuals who show an interest in building, creating, collecting, participating in, or contributing to the growth of DACAT.

The Rookie Card is a symbol of recognition and community participation. It is not a purchase, investment contract, security, or promise of future rewards, compensation, or financial benefit.

Rookie Card holders may be considered for future community activities, events, contests, recognition programs, and Rookie of the Year initiatives as determined by community members. Participation in any future activity, program, or recognition is not guaranteed.

Welcome to DACAT!

We hope you have an amazing 2026 rookie season and go on to become a true DACAT LEGEND.

https://www.dacatworld.com

https://www.dacat.fun

Visit the DACAT WORLD store:
https://dacat.store

items.name: DAFOREMAN - 5 TRILLION DACAT CLUB MEMBERSHIP
items.description:
Exclusive 1-of-1 NFT minted in recognition of DAFOREMAN.ETH as a member of the DACAT 5 TRILLION CLUB.

The DACAT 5 TRILLION CLUB is a recognition program created to honor the most dedicated and conviction-driven holders in the DACAT community. This exclusive digital badge commemorates ownership of at least 5,000,000,000,000 DACAT tokens in a single ENS Ethereum wallet and serves as a symbol of extraordinary commitment to the DACAT vision. Representing one of the highest membership tiers within the ecosystem, the 5 TRILLION CLUB recognizes those who have demonstrated exceptional belief in the future of DACAT and the decentralized creator movement.

More than a collectible, this badge stands as a permanent mark of support, loyalty, and participation in helping build a community-powered entertainment universe where creators, collectors, and supporters can Build Their World With DACAT.

If this NFT badge is held in an ENS Ethereum wallet together with the accompanying 5 Trillion DACAT Tokens, the holder may be eligible for future recognition initiatives, community acknowledgements, or other opportunities that may be created and voluntarily provided by members or supporters of the DACAT community.

This NFT is issued solely as a commemorative recognition badge. Ownership of this NFT does not create any contractual rights, ownership interests, revenue-sharing rights, investment rights, or entitlement to compensation of any kind. Any future recognition, benefits, or acknowledgements are entirely discretionary and are not guaranteed, promised, or obligated by the creator, issuer, or community. 

https://www.dacatworld.com

https://www.dacat.fun

items.name: DACAT 500 BILLION CLUB
items.description:
